decisions.rationale: Stefano is listed with Elisa and with Maura at the same events on the same dates (Milan 2026-03-20, Massa 2026-06-05), so they are different couples.
Stef Mat (performer, Pisa) and Stef Matt (teacher, Milan) differ by one letter with no shared event, partner or stated country.

Steven or Stevens is paired with Audrey in every entry, the surname differs only by spelling, and the entries are in France.
